source_mapping.policy: one planned scene for each Scene Segmentation scene; plan_start/plan_end are the canonical start and end of its narration, the pause after it is gap_after_seconds, and timeline_start/timeline_end is the interval it holds on the timeline (the pause included, as in scene_plan.json)

visual_style.category: flat cinematic motion graphics, documentary explainer
visual_style.tone: contemplative and tense at first, rising to hopeful and majestic
visual_style.typography: bold clean sans-serif headlines in warm cream, with one accent word in orange; small caps style labels
visual_style.style_suffix: cinematic documentary, warm teal-orange, film grain, no text
visual_style.contrast_policy: light cream (#f2e6d0) text and bright orange (#d9582b) or teal (#2a9d9f) shapes on a deep navy (#0b1220) ground; never place text on mid-tone shapes
visual_style.safe_area_policy: Text and key graphics stay inside the central 90% of the frame (5% margin on every side). Captions and short text sit in the upper or lower caption band inside that margin (in 9:16 above the bottom 16% that phone apps cover) and never over the primary visual; only a background may fill the whole frame.

narration.text: ఇవి కేవలం శారీరక సవాల్లు మాత్రమే కావు, మానసిక సవాల్లు ఇంకా పెద్దవి.
narration.text_en: These are not just physical challenges; the mental challenges are even greater.

scene_objective.core_meaning: The hardest part of a Mars mission is not the strain on the body but the strain on the mind.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: The mental challenges outweigh the physical ones.

visual_concept.description: A typographic statement: a mind symbol above the bold words 'Mental challenges', with a smaller line beneath stating they are greater than the physical ones.
visual_concept.primary_focus: The headline 'Mental challenges' with the word 'Mental' accented
accuracy_constraints: Do not imply that physical challenges are unimportant, only that mental ones are greater
Do not depict illness or a medical diagnosis

Smaller cream caption line under the headline area
A simple line icon of a brain in teal, standing for the mind
Deep navy background with a faint warm vignette and subtle grain

element_relationships.description: The brain symbol marks the headline as being about the mind
The caption completes the comparison with physical challenges

motion_hints.description: Draw attention to the word 'Mental'
The comparison line arrives after the headline

continuity.transition_intent: Open on the dark ground that becomes deep space in the next scene

beats.description: The dark ground and the mind symbol set the theme while the narration puts the physical challenges aside.
The headline 'Mental challenges' appears, followed by the line 'Greater than physical'.

narration.text: మార్స్కు చేరడానికి సుమారు ఎనిమిది నెలల ప్రయాణం చేయాలి ఆ సమయం లో కుటుంబం భూమి సాధారణ జీవితం అన్నిటి నించి దూరంగా ఉండాలి
narration.text_en: Reaching Mars takes about eight months of travel, and during that time one must stay away from family, Earth, and everyday life.

scene_objective.core_meaning: The trip to Mars lasts about eight months, a long stretch cut off from family, Earth and ordinary life.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: The journey itself means a long separation from everything familiar.

visual_concept.description: A schematic route across deep space from Earth on the left to Mars on the right, with a single small spacecraft travelling along it and leaving Earth far behind.
visual_concept.primary_focus: The long route line between Earth and Mars with the lone spacecraft on it
accuracy_constraints: The route is schematic: do not imply exact distances, orbits, trajectory shape or scale
The duration is approximate ('about eight months'), not an exact figure
Do not show a crew size or any dates

A small flat teal disc with simple land shapes representing Earth, the home left behind
A small flat orange-red disc representing Mars, the destination

Deep navy space with sparse faint stars and subtle grain

narration.text: అక్కడికి చేరుకున్నాక కూడా భూమితో సంభాషణ తక్షణం జరగదు సందేశాలకు నిమిషాల ఆలస్యం ఉంటుంది
narration.text_en: Even after arriving there, communication with Earth is not instant. Messages are delayed by several minutes.

scene_objective.core_meaning: Even on Mars, talking to Earth is never live: every message takes several minutes to arrive.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: Communication with Earth is delayed by minutes, so there is no instant conversation.

visual_concept.description: A signal diagram: a message pulse leaves Mars and creeps along a link toward Earth while a caption names the delay.
visual_concept.primary_focus: The signal link between Mars and Earth with a slow pulse travelling along it
accuracy_constraints: Do not state an exact number of minutes; the narration only says 'several minutes'
The link is schematic: no exact distances, scale or orbits
The direction shown is illustrative; the delay applies to messages in both directions
Do not imply the connection is broken, only delayed

A flat teal disc representing Earth, where the message is awaited

narration.text: చుట్టు ఎర్రటి ఎడారి నిశ్శబ్ద వాతావరణం పరిమితమైన మనుష్యులు మాత్రమే ఇవన్ని మనసును గట్టిగా పరీక్షిస్తాయి
narration.text_en: A red desert all around, a silent atmosphere. With only a limited number of people, all of this puts the mind to a severe test.

scene_objective.core_meaning: Life on Mars means endless red desert, silence and only a handful of companions, and that isolation tests the mind hard.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: The emptiness and isolation of Mars are a severe psychological test.

visual_concept.description: A stylised wide Martian desert under a dusty sky with one tiny group of astronaut silhouettes in the middle, dwarfed by the empty landscape.
visual_concept.primary_focus: The tiny crew group surrounded by empty red desert
accuracy_constraints: Show one small group without a countable or stated number of people
Do not show an accident, distress or an emergency
The landscape is stylised, not a real location on Mars

narration.text: ఏదేనా అత్యవసర పరిస్థితి వచ్చిన వెంటనే భూమినుంచి సహాయం అందదు అక్కడి బృందం తమ జ్ఞానం శిక్షణ పరస్పర నమ్మకం తోనే నిర్ణయాలు తీసుకోవాలి
narration.text_en: If an emergency arises, help from Earth will not arrive immediately. The team there must make decisions using only their knowledge, training, and mutual trust.

scene_objective.core_meaning: When something goes wrong, Earth is too far away to help in time, so the crew must decide for themselves using what they know, how they trained and their trust in each other.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: On Mars the team is on its own and must rely on knowledge, training and mutual trust.

visual_concept.description: A contrast across the frame: a small, distant Earth on the left with a long faint help line that does not reach in time, and the crew group on the right ringed by three linked supports that stand for knowledge, training and trust.
visual_concept.primary_focus: The self-reliant crew group ringed by its three supports
accuracy_constraints: The emergency is hypothetical: do not depict a specific accident, damage or injury
Do not imply that Earth never helps, only that help is not immediate
Show the crew as one group without a stated number of people
The help line is schematic: no distances, times or scale

narration.text: అందుకే బలమైన మనోధైర్యం క్రమశిక్షణ జట్టు భావన అత్యంత కీలకం
narration.text_en: That is why strong mental resilience, discipline, and team spirit are extremely important.

scene_objective.core_meaning: Because the crew is on its own, inner strength, discipline and a sense of team are the decisive qualities.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: Mental resilience, discipline and team spirit are extremely important for Mars.

narration.text: అయినా కూడా ఇదే మనిషి తదుపరి లక్ష్యం మొదట చంద్రుడి తర్వాత మార్స్ మన గమ్యం ఒక రోజు
narration.text_en: Even so, this is humanity's next goal. First the Moon, then Mars is our destination. One day, if humans settle there successfully,

scene_objective.core_meaning: Despite the hardships, Mars remains humanity's next step: the Moon comes first, then Mars.
scene_objective.audience_takeaway: The path forward is Moon first, then Mars.

narration.text: అక్కడ మనిషి విజయవంతంగా స్థిరపడితే అది కేవలం అంతరిక్ష విజయం మాత్రమే కాదు మానవ చరిత్ర లో ఒక కొత్త అధ్యాయం
narration.text_en: it will not be just a victory in space, but a new chapter in human history.

scene_objective.audience_takeaway: A Mars settlement would be a milestone for all of human history.
